app.name: Prutet
app.tagline: A calm place to keep evidence safe.

home.tagline: Capture, encrypt, and anchor — without revealing who you are.
home.privacyNote: Everything is encrypted on this device before it goes anywhere else.

onboarding.title: Set up Prutet
onboarding.intro1: Prutet generates a fresh on-chain identity that is not linked to your name, email, or phone.
onboarding.intro2: You will choose a passcode that protects everything stored on this device.
onboarding.bullet1: No accounts, no servers, no profiles.
onboarding.bullet2: Evidence is encrypted before it leaves your device.
onboarding.bullet3: You can burn this identity at any time.
onboarding.prefsHelp: Pick the language, region, and contrast that suit you. You can change these later.
onboarding.passcodeHelp: Choose at least eight characters. There is no recovery — only your passcode unlocks the vault.
onboarding.passcodeWarn: If you forget this passcode, the vault on this device cannot be recovered.

lock.title: Welcome back
lock.subtitle: Enter your passcode to unlock the vault.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.empty: No evidence yet. Tap Record when you need to.

proof.title: Generate proof
proof.intro: Share what you choose, nothing more. The proof shows that an item exists with these properties without revealing the item or who you are.
proof.slotOutOfRange: The anchor slot is outside the chosen range.

settings.title: Settings
settings.burnBody: This permanently destroys the keys and evidence on this device. Anchored hashes remain on Solana but can no longer be linked to you. This cannot be undone.
settings.burnConfirm1: Are you sure? Everything on this device will be erased.

emergency.confirmBody: Tap the number below to call your local emergency line, or open a support resource.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

legal.erasure: You have the right to erasure. Burning your identity removes the keys that link you to anchored evidence on this device.
